div.class: border rounded bg-light p-3 mb-3 o_cs_screen_guide
div.p: What is this screen? The control center for optional Customer Success automation and support-hours rules.

ul.li: Turn individual ✦ assistants on or off.
Select which products create support-hours wallets.
Set package validity, low-balance limits, and expiry warnings.

div.p: Start here: Configure support products and limits first. Before enabling any ✦ feature, read what data it sends, decide who reviews the output, and define how the team will use it.

setting.help: Analyse support ticket sentiment with the AI agent to feed the health score and trigger service-recovery alerts. Ticket text is sent to the configured AI provider.
A daily job recommends the next best action per customer based on their situation and history. The customer snapshot is sent to the configured AI provider.
A scheduled job gradually generates a short AI profile summary (situation, scope, field of work, tenure) shown under each customer's name. The customer snapshot is sent to the AI provider.
A daily job predicts each customer's churn probability at 30/60/90 days (with the top drivers) from its situation and KPI history, for all active customers.
A daily job builds a renewal play (which lever to pull plus dated steps) for every customer inside the 90-day renewal window.
A weekly job delivers each CSM a ranked worklist of the accounts in their portfolio that need attention this week.
Let CSMs generate a reviewable draft of customer objectives, success criteria, known stakeholders and milestones. The customer snapshot is sent to the configured AI provider.
Draft a grounded agenda, observations, questions, risks, and needs to validate from the frozen review snapshot. Confirmed value and commitments remain manual.

Send aggregate adoption metrics and the optional blocker description to the configured AI provider. Evidence text and customer records are not sent; AI does not collect telemetry or alter confirmed metrics.
Select prepaid time products that represent support-hour packages. Packages already used on Helpdesk tickets are detected automatically.
Default validity from the confirmed order date when monitoring package expiry.
Create Customer Success attention signals before prepaid support hours run out.
Warn the CSM this many days before the support package expires.

Scan the Google Sheet first. Odoo reads the font color of row-1 column titles and fills the detected scope below. Review that scope, then explicitly approve it. Revoke approval and scan again before changing the sheet.

Before every run, inspect the font color of each column-title cell in row 1. Write only to columns whose title text is red. Customer matching uses exact signals first and the AI matching agent for unresolved rows; uncertain matches are skipped.
Paste the service-account JSON. Share the Google Sheet with the client_email inside this JSON as Editor.

field.name: help
field.p: Configure optional AI assistants, support-wallet products, balance thresholds, package validity, and expiry warnings. Enable only the automations your team will review and operate.
